decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The proposal, by reason of inconsistent and conflicting information in relation to the heritage impacts
associated with the locally listed </span>Vine
Cottage building, has failed to demonstrate the level of harm that may be caused to the structure which makes a positive contribution to the site and locality.&nbsp; &nbsp;In the absence of consistent information, the local planning authority has been unable to make a comprehensive heritage assessment,<span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span>contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CS 1 D of the Harrow Core Strategy
(2012) and Policy DM7 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan
(2013).<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-ansi-language:EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The </span><span lang="EN-US" style="">application
site, located within PTAL 1b, is located in an unsustainable location and fails
to provide </span>easily
accessible public transport options and sufficient shops, services and community facilities
appropriate to the needs of the intended occupiers of the care home. T<span lang="EN-US" style="">he proposal is therefore&nbsp;</span>contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),Policies S2 and H13 of the London Plan (2021), policy CS 1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM2 and DM29 of the Harrow Local Plan (July 2013),&nbsp;</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;">The proposal, has failed to adequately
demonstrate, through the provision of a robust Transport Assessment, that the
proposed development would not give rise to issues of overspill parking and conflict
between pedestrians and vehicles within and surrounding the application site, therefore
potentially resulting in adverse impacts upon the performance and safety of the highway network. As such, <span lang="EN-US" style="">the
proposal is </span>contrary
to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H13, T3,T4, T6 of the London Plan (2021), policy CS 1 S of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and policies DM1, DM42, DM 43 and DM44 of the Harrow
Local Plan (July 2013).</p>

<p style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The proposal has failed to
adequately assess and demonstrate a need for the development in this location.&nbsp; As such, the proposal would fail to contribute towards local needs and mixed and sustainable communities</span>&nbsp;and is therefore contrary to the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies S2 and H13 of the London Plan (2021),
Policy CS1.I of the Harrow Core Strategy and Policy DM 29 of the Harrow
Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The proposed development by reason
of inadequate archaeological evaluation of the application site within a Scheduled
Ancient Monument, has failed to demonstrate that potential archaeological
assets of significant importance would not be harmed and impacts minimised
through appropriate design and construction. The proposal would therefore fail
to comply the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policy HC1 C and D of
The London Plan (2021), policy CS1 D of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and
policy DM 7 of the Harrow Development Management Polices Local Plan (2013).&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The application has failed to
adequately assess energy and sustainability impacts, including </span>Energy, Whole Life Carbon, and Circular Economy
matters, <span lang="EN-US" style="">as a result of
the proposed development. Without an adequate assessment the local planning authority
is unable to determine the suitability of the development in the first instance
and whether mitigation measures may be required to address such matters. As
such, the proposal is </span>contrary to the National Planning
Policy Framework (2024), Policies
SI2, SI7 and D3 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DM12 and DM14 of the
Harrow Local Plan (2013).<span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-ansi-language:EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;">The proposed development would result in an unacceptable level of tree
loss across the application site, which is subject to a site wide Tree
Preservation Order, with the density and size of development proposed adversely
impacting upon the health and appearance of retained trees and with insufficient
space within the site to provide sufficient mitigation. As such, the <span lang="EN-US" style="">proposal is </span>contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies G1, G6 and G7
of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DM20 and DM22 of the Harrow Local Plan
(2013).<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-ansi-language:EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;">Th</span><span style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;">e development proposal would result in inappropriate development within the Green Belt and
upon which substantial harm to the openness of the Green Belt would occur.
Furthermore, the development would not constitute Grey Belt development and no very special
circumstances have been demonstrated by the applicant whereby the harm by
reason of inappropriateness, other harm from the proposal and the substantial harm to the openness of the Green
Belt is outweighed by other considerations. The </span><span lang="EN-US" style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;">proposal is therefore </span><span style="text-align: justify; text-indent: -18pt;">contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policy G2 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CS1F of the Harrow Core Strategy
and Policy DM16 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:
0cm;margin-left:19.75pt;mso-add-space:auto;text-align:justify;text-justify:
inter-ideograph;text-indent:-18.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-pagination:widow-orphan;
mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:
EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;">The proposed development would result in an unacceptable loss of Biodiversity
on site which has not been sufficiently justified and fails to deliver acceptable biodiversity net gain. Furthermore,
the proposed landscaping does not seek to provide an ecologically sound wildlife
corridor or appropriate green infrastructure across the site and therefore does not deliver a benefit to local
wildlife in this green belt location.&nbsp; &nbsp;The <span lang="EN-US" style="">proposal is therefore&nbsp;</span>contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies G1, G2, G6 and
G7 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DM20, DM21 and DM22 of the Harrow
Local Plan (2013).<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;color:red;mso-ansi-language:
EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The proposed development would
result in adverse amenity impacts for future occupiers of the development
through the lack of defensible space at ground floor level resulting in unreasonable loss of privacy to habitable
room windows and through the failure to demonstrate through the provision of a
Daylight Sunlight Assessment and through window design solutions to building 9,
that sufficient light levels and shadowing would be secured.&nbsp; T</span>he <span lang="EN-US" style="">proposal is therefore&nbsp;</span>contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 D.7 of
the London Plan (2021) and Policy DM1 of the Harrow Local Plan
(2013).<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-ansi-language:EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The proposal has failed to provide any form of
affordable housing provision on or off site and has failed to demonstrate why
such affordable housing provision should not be provided.&nbsp; &nbsp;The proposed development would therefore fail to contribute towards mixed and sustainable communities and the local
planning authority is unable to determine the suitability of the development in
the first instance.&nbsp; &nbsp;The proposal is therefore </span>contrary
to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H4, H5 and H13
of the London Plan (2021), and policy CS1.I of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and policy DM 24 of the Harrow Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.75pt; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The application has failed to adequately assess the noise impacts of the
proposal, with insufficient levels of noise survey data secured. As such, the
local planning authority is unable to fully assess the impacts of the proposal on the
future occupiers to ensure a high standard of residential amenity is achieved.&nbsp; T</span><span lang="EN-US" style="">he proposal is therefore&nbsp;</span>contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policy D3 D.7 and D14 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DM1 of the Harrow
Local Plan (July 2013).<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:12.0pt;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ansi-language:EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
description:
Alteration, extension and conversion of existing buildings
(engineers cottage, east gate lodge and vine cottage) and the erection of a
part single, part two, part three and part four storey building comprising a 70
bed care home (class c2) with parking provisions and hard and soft landscape
works (demolition of buildings 2-5)
site_name: Vine Cottage, Royal National Orthopaedic Hospital
